page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.7xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 16 physical Intel Xeon 8163 cores running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-threaded and multi-threaded capabilities. Single-core performance is relatively weak, as shown by lower scores in single-core stress-ng, Geekbench, and single-threaded gzip compression tests. However, the 32-vCPU configuration delivers average multi-core performance across stress-ng, Passmark, and Geekbench multi-threaded suites. Memory bandwidth is average for both cached small-block and uncached large-block operations, though the overall Passmark memory score falls into the lower quartile.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, this instance offers a balanced resource density suitable for workloads that can leverage multi-threaded execution to offset the modest single-core speeds. It is well-suited for multi-threaded applications such as static web serving, software compilation, database operations, and moderate Redis deployments. It can also handle basic text processing and small-to-medium language model inference tasks, though it is not optimized for heavy single-threaded computations or GPU-accelerated workloads.
